prologue.text: Hello? Oh! You must be the new owner. I’m Maya.
The high street surgery closed. Half the town has a cough and nowhere to go.
I’m a nurse. Open this place and I’ll work here. I’ve even brought biscuits.
Sorry, I didn’t catch your name?
Nice to meet you, {name}! Where do we start?
replies: My office. Every boss needs a desk.

steps.text: Is that a box of… more boxes?
A desk, a computer and a chair that spins. Very bossy.
Reception next. People need somewhere to say ‘it’s my knee’.
And a bell. Everyone loves a bell.
Our first patient! Don’t panic. I’m panicking a bit.
They’ll need somewhere to sit. Apparently the floor doesn’t count.
Chairs facing the nursing rooms, so nobody feels forgotten.
Now my room. I can see the floor! Mostly.
Bed, lamp, cabinet. That’s a nursing room. That’s my nursing room.
Word travels fast. That’s… a queue.
I can’t treat them and check them in. We need someone on the desk!

reactions.text: Our first coins! Let’s not spend them all on biscuits.
Before they start a queue for the queue.
We’re open, {name}. Welcome to Little Lifeline.
Look at you, sleeves rolled up!

lessons.text: Better kit means quicker care. Let’s upgrade my equipment.
